# Resilience Alpha Research

> A daily geopolitical-intelligence publication for investors, written by Marcus Vail: supply chains, energy, critical minerals, export controls, and the market exposure underneath them.

Resilience Alpha Research publishes one new issue every morning. It is free to read. The publication tracks how geopolitics moves real assets and the companies exposed to them.

## Key pages
- [Latest issue](https://resiliencealpha.com/): today's analysis
- [Archive](https://resiliencealpha.com/archive.html): every past issue
- [Subscribe](https://resiliencealpha.com/subscribe.html): get new issues by email
- [About](https://resiliencealpha.com/about.html): what Resilience Alpha is and how it works
